entities.summary: The Hanabila Mosque, also called the Muzaffari Mosque, is an early Ayyubid-era mosque in Damascus, Syria. The mosque was in use by 604 AH (1207/1208 CE); with the minaret completed in 606 AH (1209/1210 CE). The mosque was founded by Abu Umar Muhammad bin Qudama al-Muqaddasi, and funded with the assistance of al-Malik al-Muzaffar Gokburi.
